column4: なんとか永久地下牢を突破した
column5: They somehow broke through the permanent underground prison.

column4: 封印の間に付いた。
column5: Arrived at the sealing chamber.

column4: 中央に魔人カミーラが居る（封印カミーラ）
column5: In the center is the Fiend Camilla (sealed Camilla).

column4: ランスか久しぶりだな・・２年と８ヶ月ぶりだ
column5: Rance, it's been a while... two years and eight months.

column4: また私を辱めに来たのか、それとも殺しに来たのか
column5: Have you come to disgrace me again, or to kill me?

column4: 過去、ランスがカミーラの元に来たのは４回
column5: In the past, Rance has come to Camilla four times.

column4: やってきてはエッチする、俺の女になれとか言うが断られている
column5: He came, had sex, said 'be my woman,' but was refused.

column4: お前がその気になるまで何度でも来るぞ（とかいいつ２年半開けてしまった）
column5: I'll come as many times as it takes until you agree (though he actually took two and a half years off).

column4: 今回が５回目
column5: This is the fifth time.

column4: 悪態はついているが、２年半ぶりとか待っていた感じ
column5: Though she insults him, it feels like she's been waiting after two and a half years.

column4: 実は・・他に誰も来ないし、少しずつランスに依存していた
column5: Actually... no one else has come, and she's gradually become dependent on Rance.

column4: だが、それは絶対に表には出さないし、自分も気がついていない
column5: But she would never show that outwardly, and she doesn't even realize it herself.

column4: サテラの存在に気が付くと、そうか・・お前はホーネット側についたのか
column5: Noticing Satella's presence, she says, 'I see... you've sided with Hornet.'

column4: 今日こそ私を殺しに来たのだな
column5: Today you have come to kill me, haven't you?

column4: そうよとサテラ、そうじゃとカオス
column5: 'Yes,' says Satella. 'That's right,' says Chaos.

column4: だがランスは、そんな事はしない、可愛い女は全て俺の物だ。
column5: But Rance won't do that; all cute women belong to me.

column4: ここから出してやる、ついてこい。
column5: I'll get you out of here. Follow me.

column4: イヤだ、お前なんかについていかない
column5: No, I won't follow someone like you.

column4: 困ったな、ケイブリスがもうすぐここやってくる。
column5: This is troublesome; Kayblis will be here soon.

column4: ケイブリスの事を知ると、素直に従う。
column5: When they learn about Kayblis, they obey obediently.
